query: SELECT mol_id, greedy_clusters_0p5, greedy_clusters_1p0, largest_cluster_fraction_1p0, post_pb_confs FROM per_ligand_long WHERE ligand_set = ? AND method = ?
aggregation: Arithmetic means of cluster counts and largest-cluster fractions over identical defined-entry sets per method: 92 NExT-Mol, 93 MCF, 94 others. Largest-cluster fraction is max(cluster population)/retained ensemble size per molecule, displayed as a percentage. Retained counts use all 94 entries.
sort: Ascending unrounded mean cluster count at 0.5 Angstrom; stored ChEMBL3D-PB ensemble placed last separately.
note: Read-only aggregation of archived cluster counts; no new conformer generation or clustering.
highlighting: Largest two distinct unrounded values for retained count and cluster counts; smallest two for largest-cluster fraction. Ties share formatting, including the stored reference. Retained count describes yield, not diversity.
